title: ln-ashlar Events by Component Catalog
description: Machine-readable catalog of events emitted and listened to per component. Generated from source by scripts/sync-ln-events.mjs — do not hand-edit. The detail field is a human-readable signature, not a machine-checkable type. The source field indicates per-entry provenance ('static' or 'dynamic-allowlist').

emits.name: ln-list:page-failed
emits.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-list-window`): the coordinator reports that the page fetch at `offset` failed. The component releases that offset from its window cache's in-flight set so a later `ensure()` pass can request it again; there is no automatic retry.

emits.name: ln-list:request-invalidate
emits.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-list-window`): invalidates the window cache and resets to page 0.

emits.name: ln-list:request-revalidate
emits.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-list-window`): the coordinator asks the component to refresh through its window cache after a local mutation. The cache refetches the page covering the current viewport rather than page 0, and the resident rows stay visible until the replacement arrives.

emits.name: ln-list:set-data
emits.description: Populates the list with a dataset, removes loading overlays, and triggers render. Windowed mode (`data-ln-list-window`) additionally reads `offset`/`queryGen` off the payload, routing it into the internal window cache.
emits.detail: { data: Array, total: Number, filtered: Number, offset?: Number, queryGen?: Number }

emits.name: ln-list:set-loading
emits.description: Controls the visual loading state of the list.

emits.name: ln-options:set-data
emits.description: Delivers all records to a bound options binder.

emits.name: ln-stat:set-count
emits.description: Delivers the resolved count to a bound stat binder.

emits.name: ln-table:page-failed
emits.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-table-window`): the coordinator reports that the page fetch at `offset` failed. The component releases that offset from its window cache's in-flight set so a later `ensure()` pass can request it again; there is no automatic retry.

emits.name: ln-table:request-revalidate
emits.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-table-window`): the coordinator asks the component to refresh through its window cache after a local mutation. The cache refetches the page covering the current viewport rather than page 0, and the resident rows stay visible until the replacement arrives.

emits.name: ln-table:set-data
emits.description: Populates the table with a raw dataset (Data-Driven mode). Windowed mode (`data-ln-table-window`) additionally reads `offset`/`queryGen` off the payload, routing it into the internal window cache.
emits.detail: { data: Array, total: Number, filtered: Number, offset?: Number, queryGen?: Number }

emits.name: ln-table:set-loading
emits.description: Toggles the `.ln-table--loading` class (Data-Driven mode).

listens.description: Store change notifications — on any of these, re-queries and re-serves all non-windowed bound view elements using their last cached query. emits.name: ln-list:rendered
emits.description: Dispatched after items are appended/redrawn in the DOM.
emits.detail: { list: String, total: Number, visible: Number }

emits.name: ln-list:request-data
emits.description: Dispatched on initialization or parameter changes (sort, search, filter) to request data. Windowed mode (`data-ln-list-window`) additionally emits `offset`/`limit`/`queryGen`.
emits.detail: { list: String, sort: Object, filters: Object, search: String, offset?: Number, limit?: Number, queryGen?: Number }

emits.name: ln-list:select
emits.description: Dispatched when item selection changes.
emits.detail: { list: String, selectedIds: Set, count: Number }

emits.name: ln-list:select-all
emits.description: Dispatched when the global "Select All" checkbox status changes.

emits.name: ln-list:sorted
emits.description: Dispatched in SSR mode when items are sorted.
emits.detail: { field: String, direction: String, matched: Number, total: Number }

listens.name: ln-filter:change
listens.description: In SSR mode, filters in-memory records by key/values and updates the virtual view. In Data-Driven mode, `ln-filter` targets the Store directly.
listens.detail: { key: String, values: Array, targetId: String }

listens.name: ln-list:page-failed
listens.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-list-window`): the coordinator reports that the page fetch at `offset` failed. The component releases that offset from its window cache's in-flight set so a later `ensure()` pass can request it again; there is no automatic retry.

listens.name: ln-list:request-clear-filters
listens.description: Resets all active filters and search term. In Data-Driven mode, dispatches `ln-list:clear-filters` and requests fresh data; in SSR mode, re-evaluates in-memory filters.

listens.name: ln-list:request-invalidate
listens.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-list-window`): invalidates the window cache and resets to page 0.

listens.name: ln-list:request-revalidate
listens.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-list-window`): the coordinator asks the component to refresh through its window cache after a local mutation. The cache refetches the page covering the current viewport rather than page 0, and the resident rows stay visible until the replacement arrives.

listens.name: ln-list:set-data
listens.description: Populates the list with a dataset, removes loading overlays, and triggers render. Windowed mode (`data-ln-list-window`) additionally reads `offset`/`queryGen` off the payload, routing it into the internal window cache.
listens.detail: { data: Array, total: Number, filtered: Number, offset?: Number, queryGen?: Number }

listens.name: ln-list:set-loading
listens.description: Controls the visual loading state of the list.

listens.name: ln-search:change
listens.description: In SSR mode, filters in-memory records by search tokens and updates the virtual view. In Data-Driven mode, `ln-search` targets the Store directly.

listens.name: ln-sort:change
listens.description: In Data-Driven mode with `field !== null`, sets `currentSort`, re-sorts `_filteredData` locally (non-windowed) or calls `_requestData()` for fresh slice (windowed). In SSR mode, sorts in-memory records by field/value and updates the virtual view.
listens.detail: { field: String|null, column: Number|null, direction: 'asc'|'desc'|'none', targetId: String }

emits.name: ln-modal:before-close
emits.description: Dispatched upon request to close; calling `preventDefault()` cancels closing.

emits.name: ln-modal:before-open
emits.description: Dispatched when state changes to `"open"`, before styles or focus are applied.

emits.name: ln-modal:close
emits.description: Dispatched after modal closes, before focus restoration.

emits.name: ln-modal:destroyed
emits.description: Dispatched when the component instance is destroyed.

emits.name: ln-modal:open
emits.description: Dispatched once modal is natively open, body scroll locked, and initial focus set.
emits.detail: { modalId: String, target: HTMLElement, hashNs: String?, param: String? }

listens.name: ln-modal:request-close
listens.description: Command request event sent to close the modal.

listens.name: ln-modal:request-open
listens.description: Command request event sent to open the modal.

emits.name: ln-nav:before-update
emits.description: Dispatched before evaluating and updating active link states. Cancelable.

emits.name: ln-nav:destroyed
emits.description: Dispatched when `destroy()` is called on the component instance.

emits.name: ln-nav:update
emits.description: Dispatched after active link states have been evaluated and CSS classes applied.

emits.name: ln-number:destroyed
emits.description: Dispatched when the component is destroyed.

emits.name: ln-number:input
emits.description: Dispatched upon user input or programmatic value changes.

emits.name: ln-options:request-data
emits.description: Dispatched on load to request option records.

listens.name: ln-options:set-data
listens.description: Listens for the array of options to render.

emits.name: ln-popover:before-close
emits.description: Fires before close, letting the app prevent closing via `e.preventDefault()`.
emits.detail: { popoverId: String, target: HTMLElement, trigger: HTMLElement? }

emits.name: ln-popover:before-open
emits.description: Fires after attribute changes to `"open"`, before top-layer promotion or placement calculations.
emits.detail: { popoverId: String, target: HTMLElement, trigger: HTMLElement? }

emits.name: ln-popover:close
emits.description: Fires after popover is hidden, inline styles cleared, and focus restored.
emits.detail: { popoverId: String, target: HTMLElement, trigger: HTMLElement? }

emits.name: ln-popover:destroyed
emits.description: Fires when the popover instance is destroyed.

emits.name: ln-popover:open
emits.description: Fires once the popover is visible in the top layer, positioned, and focus set.
emits.detail: { popoverId: String, target: HTMLElement, trigger: HTMLElement? }

emits.name: ln-progress:change
emits.description: Dispatched on construction and every time value or max attributes change.
emits.detail: { target: HTMLElement, value: Number, max: Number, percentage: Number }

emits.name: ln-router:before-navigate
emits.description: Dispatched before navigation starts. Calling `preventDefault()` aborts route swap.
emits.detail: { from: String, to: String, params: Object, query: Object }

emits.name: ln-router:navigated
emits.description: Dispatched on each updated target container after DOM replacement and focus setup.
emits.detail: { path, params, query, route, target, region }

emits.name: ln-router:not-found
emits.description: Dispatched when no route matches the requested URL.

emits.name: ln-search:change
emits.description: Dispatched when search term updates. `preventDefault()` skips default DOM show/hide.
emits.detail: { term: string, tokens: string[], targetId: string, fields: string[]|null }

emits.name: ln-sort:change
emits.description: Dispatched on the **target** (never on the sort control itself) on trigger click or persisted-state restore. `preventDefault()` hands the sort intent fully to the consumer and skips the default DOM reorder.
emits.detail: { field: String|null, column: Number|null, direction: 'asc'|'desc'|'none', targetId: String }

listens.name: ln-sort:change
listens.description: Listens on target container to enforce mutual exclusion across sibling `ln-sort` controls and synchronize duplicate controls.
listens.detail: { field: String|null, column: Number|null, direction: 'asc'|'desc'|'none', targetId: String }

emits.name: ln-sortable:before-drag
emits.description: Dispatched on `pointerdown` before starting a drag. If canceled, dragging is aborted.

emits.name: ln-sortable:destroyed
emits.description: Dispatched when the instance is destroyed.

emits.name: ln-sortable:disabled
emits.description: Dispatched when `data-ln-sortable` changes to `"disabled"`.

emits.name: ln-sortable:drag-start
emits.description: Dispatched when dragging commences and pointer capture is acquired.

emits.name: ln-sortable:enabled
emits.description: Dispatched when transitioning from `"disabled"` to active.

emits.name: ln-sortable:reordered
emits.description: Dispatched upon pointer release ONLY if the DOM index changed.
emits.detail: { item: HTMLElement, oldIndex: number, newIndex: number }

emits.name: ln-stat:request-count
emits.description: Dispatched on initialization to ask the coordinator to resolve the count.

listens.name: ln-stat:set-count
listens.description: Received from the coordinator when the count is resolved, triggers rendering.

emits.name: ln-table:clear-filters
emits.description: Emitted on clear-all button click, before requesting fresh data (Data-Driven mode).

emits.name: ln-table:empty
emits.description: Emitted when the empty-state template is rendered (SSR and Data-Driven modes).

emits.name: ln-table:filter
emits.description: Emitted after applying search, column filter, or clear actions locally (SSR mode).
emits.detail: { term: String, matched: Number, total: Number }

emits.name: ln-table:ready
emits.description: Fired once after initial row hydration/parsing completes (SSR and Data-Driven modes).

emits.name: ln-table:rendered
emits.description: Fired after `ln-table:set-data` finishes rendering (Data-Driven mode).
emits.detail: { table: String, total: Number, visible: Number }

emits.name: ln-table:request-data
emits.description: Requests a new data page from the coordinator whenever sort/filter/search state changes, including the initial mount (Data-Driven mode). Windowed mode (`data-ln-table-window`) additionally emits `offset`/`limit`/`queryGen`.
emits.detail: { table: String, sort: Object|null, filters: Object, search: String, offset?: Number, limit?: Number, queryGen?: Number }

emits.name: ln-table:row-action
emits.description: Emitted on a row action button click (Data-Driven mode).
emits.detail: { table: String, id: String, action: String, record: Object }

emits.name: ln-table:row-click
emits.description: Emitted on row left-click or `Enter` keypress (Data-Driven mode).
emits.detail: { table: String, id: String, record: Object }

emits.name: ln-table:search
emits.description: Emitted when receiving an `ln-table:set-search` command (dispatched by `ln-table-coordinator` in response to `ln-search:change`), before requesting fresh data (Data-Driven mode).

emits.name: ln-table:select
emits.description: Emitted on individual row selection toggle and after select-all (Data-Driven mode).
emits.detail: { table: String, selectedIds: Set, count: Number }

emits.name: ln-table:select-all
emits.description: Emitted when the header "select all" checkbox is toggled (Data-Driven mode).

emits.name: ln-table:sorted
emits.description: Emitted after applying a local sort (SSR mode).
emits.detail: { column: Number, direction: String|null, matched: Number, total: Number }

listens.name: ln-filter:change
listens.description: Consumed directly on itself in SSR mode only (`!this.isDataDriven`), applying column filters to the in-memory `_data` cache.
listens.detail: { key: String, values: Array, targetId: String }

listens.name: ln-search:change
listens.description: Consumed directly on itself in SSR mode only, triggering local in-memory search matching. In Data-Driven mode `ln-table-coordinator` intercepts this event on the search input's target and dispatches `ln-table:set-search` instead.

listens.name: ln-sort:change
listens.description: Column sort intent from [`ln-sort`](./ln-sort.md). SSR mode re-orders in-memory rows locally and dispatches `ln-table:sorted`; Data-Driven mode sets `currentSort` and dispatches a fresh `ln-table:request-data`. `ln-table` always calls `preventDefault()`, superseding `ln-sort`'s own default DOM-reorder fallback.
listens.detail: { field: String|null, column: Number|null, direction: 'asc'|'desc'|'none', targetId: String }

listens.name: ln-table:page-failed
listens.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-table-window`): the coordinator reports that the page fetch at `offset` failed. The component releases that offset from its window cache's in-flight set so a later `ensure()` pass can request it again; there is no automatic retry.

listens.name: ln-table:request-clear-filters
listens.description: Dispatched to child SSR `[data-ln-table]` element on clear button click.

listens.name: ln-table:request-revalidate
listens.description: Windowed mode (`data-ln-table-window`): the coordinator asks the component to refresh through its window cache after a local mutation. The cache refetches the page covering the current viewport rather than page 0, and the resident rows stay visible until the replacement arrives.

listens.name: ln-table:set-data
listens.description: Populates the table with a raw dataset (Data-Driven mode). Windowed mode (`data-ln-table-window`) additionally reads `offset`/`queryGen` off the payload, routing it into the internal window cache.
listens.detail: { data: Array, total: Number, filtered: Number, offset?: Number, queryGen?: Number }

listens.name: ln-table:set-loading
listens.description: Toggles the `.ln-table--loading` class (Data-Driven mode).

emits.name: ln-table:request-clear-filters
emits.description: Dispatched to child SSR `[data-ln-table]` element on clear button click.

listens.name: ln-filter:change
listens.description: Caught on `data-ln-filter` inside the wrapper container to update header indicators.
listens.detail: { key: String, values: Array, targetId: String }

emits.name: ln-tabs:before-change
emits.description: Dispatched before switching active tab. Calling `preventDefault()` cancels switch and reverts state.
emits.detail: { key: String, previousKey: String, tab: HTMLElement, panel: HTMLElement, target: HTMLElement }

emits.name: ln-tabs:change
emits.description: Dispatched after panel visibility, ARIA attributes, focus, and persistence updates complete.
emits.detail: { key: String, previousKey: String, tab: HTMLElement, panel: HTMLElement, target: HTMLElement }

emits.name: ln-tabs:destroyed
emits.description: Dispatched when `destroy()` is called on the instance.

listens.name: ln-tabs:request-select
listens.description: Command request event sent to switch active tab.

emits.name: ln-toast:destroyed
emits.description: Dispatched when `destroy()` is called on the container instance.

listens.name: ln-modal:open
listens.description: Adopts hash parameter and emits `ln-fill:request` for `"edit"` mode.

listens.name: ln-toast:clear
listens.description: Clears all active toast notifications (optionally filtered by container).

listens.name: ln-toast:enqueue
listens.description: Dispatches a request to construct and append a new toast notification.
listens.detail: { type, title, message, data, timeout, container }

emits.name: ln-toggle:before-close
emits.description: Fires when the state is about to switch to `"close"`. Prevent default to block the close sequence.

emits.name: ln-toggle:before-open
emits.description: Fires when the state is about to switch to `"open"`. Prevent default to block the open sequence.

emits.name: ln-toggle:close
emits.description: Fires after the panel has fully closed.

emits.name: ln-toggle:destroyed
emits.description: Fires when the component instance is torn down.

emits.name: ln-toggle:open
emits.description: Fires after the panel has fully opened and classes are updated.

emits.name: ln-tooltip:destroyed
emits.description: Dispatched when the trigger component instance is destroyed.

emits.name: ln-translations:added
emits.description: Fires after a language's fields are cloned and the menu/badges are updated.
emits.detail: { target: HTMLElement, lang: String, langName: String }

emits.name: ln-translations:before-add
emits.description: Fires before a language's fields are cloned. `preventDefault()` aborts the activation.
emits.detail: { target: HTMLElement, lang: String, langName: String }

emits.name: ln-translations:before-remove
emits.description: Fires before a language's cloned fields are removed. `preventDefault()` aborts the removal.

emits.name: ln-translations:removed
emits.description: Fires after a language's cloned fields are removed and the menu/badges are updated.

listens.name: ln-translations:request-add
listens.description: Requests activation of a language programmatically. Event listener is bound to the container element (`data-ln-translations`), not `document`.

listens.name: ln-translations:request-remove
listens.description: Requests deactivation of a language programmatically. Event listener is bound to the container element (`data-ln-translations`), not `document`.

emits.name: ln-fill:request
emits.description: Sent to form layer to fill fields with record data upon open.

emits.name: ln-modal:request-close
emits.description: Sent to target `ln-modal` to request panel closing.

emits.name: ln-modal:request-open
emits.description: Sent to target `ln-modal` to request panel opening.

emits.name: ln-toast:enqueue
emits.description: Dispatched upon AJAX response `message` or network/server/upload error fallbacks.

listens.name: ln-ajax:error
listens.description: Relays error `message` or network/server fallback toast, keeps modal open.

listens.name: ln-ajax:success
listens.description: Relays response `message` as toast, auto-closes parent modal, resets forms.

listens.name: ln-modal:before-open
listens.description: Clears form fields if modal mode is `"new"`.

listens.name: ln-modal:close
listens.description: Cleans up modal hash segment and resets fields if mode is `"new"`.

listens.name: ln-modal:open
listens.description: Adopts hash parameter and emits `ln-fill:request` for `"edit"` mode.

listens.name: ln-upload:error
listens.description: Enqueues error toast on upload failure.

listens.name: ln-upload:invalid
listens.description: Enqueues error toast on file validation failure.

emits.name: ln-upload:before-clear
emits.description: Fires before clearing all files.

emits.name: ln-upload:before-remove
emits.description: Fires before a file is deleted/removed.

emits.name: ln-upload:before-upload
emits.description: Fires before an upload starts.

emits.name: ln-upload:cleared
emits.description: Fires after `clear()` wipes all file instances.

emits.name: ln-upload:destroyed
emits.description: Fires when component instance is torn down.

emits.name: ln-upload:error
emits.description: Fires when an upload or delete request fails.

emits.name: ln-upload:invalid
emits.description: Fires when a file fails extension/size/count validation.

emits.name: ln-upload:progress
emits.description: Fires on XHR upload progress updates.

emits.name: ln-upload:removed
emits.description: Fires after a file is deleted from server and removed from DOM.

emits.name: ln-upload:uploaded
emits.description: Fires after a file successfully uploads (2xx response).

listens.name: ln-upload:request-clear
listens.description: Inbound command to clear all files.

listens.name: ln-upload:request-remove
listens.description: Inbound command to remove a file.

listens.name: ln-upload:request-upload
listens.description: Inbound command to upload files.

emits.name: ln-validate:destroyed
emits.description: Dispatched when the component is destroyed.

emits.name: ln-validate:invalid
emits.description: Dispatched when the field transitions to an invalid state.

emits.name: ln-validate:request-validate
emits.description: The submit gate — the first `data-ln-validate` field to initialize on a form injects `novalidate` and attaches a form-level `submit` listener that dispatches this event on the form to collect invalid fields before allowing submission.

emits.name: ln-validate:valid
emits.description: Dispatched when the field transitions to a valid state.

listens.name: ln-validate:clear-custom
listens.description: Clears a custom error key.

listens.name: ln-validate:request-validate
listens.description: Every `data-ln-validate` field instance listens for this event on its parent form; when received, it marks itself touched, runs `validate()`, and pushes itself into `invalidFields` if invalid.

listens.name: ln-validate:set-custom
listens.description: Sets a manual custom error key on the input.
